scope: Read-only source review of new combined-dequant canonical/native qualification gates, study policy, current dequant focused-model status, and report-only mapping additions. No simulation, synthesis, native route, or hardware run performed.

dequant_proof_status.interpretation: The independent existing-edge operand model is not an actual RTL proof. Canonical and native qualification remain gated until an actual focused dequant RTL PASS receipt exists.

canonical_gates.baseline: Pins V109 FETCH actual native receipt, Q result, 10 ns actual pre-synthesis clock state, 18 source origins and the unchanged bench/vector inputs.
canonical_gates.profile: Only combined composition accepted. Busy, fault, and combined focused proof receipts must all be PASS/actual; the dequant proof receipt is additionally required.
canonical_gates.source_binding: Requires candidate busy/fault/dequant source hashes to match the corresponding focused receipts, while unchanged source hashes remain tied to the frozen V109 FETCH canonical source record.
canonical_gates.assertions_and_outputs: Verilator --assert and -Wall remain active; compiler warnings fail. Both frozen V109 seeds must pass 22 cases/21 directed checks each, with exact stdout/events/cycles and raw canonical artifacts matching the actual V109 FETCH control.
canonical_gates.control_reuse: V109 FETCH actual RTL is reused, not rebuilt or counted as a new V110 run.
canonical_gates.current_state: No dequant focused results.json or canonical-dequant combined results.json exists as of this audit.

native_gates.profile: native_dequant.py uses the combined-dequant canonical namespace and requires a passing actual canonical result plus busy, fault and dequant focused proof pins.
native_gates.native_source_closure: Reconstructs the 18-source closure (17 SV + one include header), checks canonical-to-origin hashes, pins V109 FETCH receipt and fixed clock, policy/recipe/tool hashes, and tests parser output against the pinned FETCH report result before preflight.
native_gates.dispatch: Requires an independently PASSed preflight audit bound to the exact preflight and policy hashes; launch capacity, no-silent-retry, adaptive-trial, and positive-repeat limits are inherited from native.py.
native_gates.trial_naming: The default combined variant and dequant tag create trial_id v110-combined-dequant, matching the new policy profile name.

policy_enforcement_note.finding: The launcher enforces the global initial-trial ceiling and native_dequant.py constrains the source composition to combined, but it accepts a caller-supplied alphanumeric --tag without checking the generated trial/profile name against study-policy.initial_variants. The policy list is therefore not a programmatic per-profile allowlist.
policy_enforcement_note.current_default: No mismatch on the default invocation: trial_id is v110-combined-dequant, one of the listed profiles.

mapping_report.fields: Each synth/place/route report emits instance, primitive, location and INIT for matching busy_owned, fault_pending and fault_ack cell names where available.
mapping_report.read_only: No set_property, KEEP, DONT_TOUCH or MAX_FANOUT preservation directive was added. The file is report-only and does not affect mapped logic.
mapping_report.other_flow_change: run_native.py emits the rich methodology report from native findings and explicitly preserves fixed 10 ns, no-waiver, no-board-I/O/complete-parent qualification limits.

related_canonical_state_at_review: Per root status, the existing combined canonical run had seed 107601 PASS and seed 107602 still running; final combined PASS remains required before native dispatch.
